title: 2026 Monthly Premium Rate Schedule, TRICARE Premium-Based Plans
content:
**TRICARE Premium-Based Plans - monthly premium per coverage month, calendar year 2026 rates (USD).**

| Tier | Monthly premium (USD per coverage month) | Rate year | When each monthly premium is due | Partial-month basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only | 61.17 | 2026 | last calendar day of the month before the coverage month | daily, by the calendar days in the month |
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family | 301.82 | 2026 | last calendar day of the month before the coverage month | daily, by the calendar days in the month |
| TRICARE Young Adult Select | 312.00 | 2026 | last calendar day of the month before the coverage month | daily, by the calendar days in the month |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only | 614.07 | 2026 | last calendar day of the month before the coverage month | daily, by the calendar days in the month |
| TRICARE Young Adult Prime | 684.00 | 2026 | last calendar day of the month before the coverage month | daily, by the calendar days in the month |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family | 1471.73 | 2026 | last calendar day of the month before the coverage month | daily, by the calendar days in the month |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The monthly premium is the amount for one whole coverage month at the tier's rate.
2. A premium for a partial month is figured daily, by the number of calendar days in that month.
3. The premium for a coverage month is due on the last calendar day of the month before it: the premium for a September coverage month is due on 31 August, and the premium for a March coverage month is due on the last day of February.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical)

- A TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family purchaser owes 1471.73 for each whole coverage month in 2026.
- The difference between the TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family and Member-Only rates is 301.82 less 61.17, that is 240.65 per whole month.
